# Newapihome Landing Replica Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build a standalone static landing page in `newapihome/` that recreates the reference homepage's centered logo, sparse floating copy field, and ambient motion.

**Architecture:** Use a plain HTML shell with a centered focus layer, a dedicated floating-copy layer generated by vanilla JavaScript, and a standalone CSS file for the black-stage look and motion system. Validate the result with a small file-contract test first, then verify the rendered page with Playwright and shared-folder file checks.

**Tech Stack:** Static HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript, SVG, Node test runner, Playwright.

---

```js
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');

const rootDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const pageDir = path.join(rootDir, 'newapihome');

function read(file) {
  return fs.readFileSync(path.join(pageDir, file), 'utf8');
}

test('newapihome landing assets exist and reference each other', () => {
  const html = read('index.html');
  const css = read('styles.css');
  const js = read('script.js');

  assert.match(html, /<main class="landing-shell">/);
  assert.match(html, /<div class="floating-copy" id="floating-copy"/);
  assert.match(html, /<img class="brand-mark" src="\.\/logo\.svg"/);
  assert.match(html, /<script src="\.\/script\.js"><\/script>/);

  assert.match(css, /body\s*\{/);
  assert.match(css, /\.floating-copy-item/);
  assert.match(css, /@keyframes floatDrift/);

  assert.match(js, /const COPY_ITEMS = \[/);
  assert.match(js, /function layoutCopyItems\(/);
});
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Create the HTML shell**

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>多元探索</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="./styles.css" />
  </head>
  <body>
    <main class="landing-shell">
      <div class="background-glow" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <div class="floating-copy" id="floating-copy" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <section class="hero-mark" aria-label="品牌主页">
        <img class="brand-mark" src="./logo.svg" alt="多元探索" />
      </section>
    </main>
    <script src="./script.js"></script>
  </body>
</html>
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Create the CSS stage and motion system**

```css
:root {
  --bg: #020202;
  --fg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
  --muted: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.34);
  --glow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--fg);
}

.landing-shell {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 100vh;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.floating-copy-item {
  position: absolute;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, var(--alpha));
  animation: floatDrift var(--duration) ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes floatDrift {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(var(--scale, 1)); }
  50% { transform: translate3d(var(--drift-x), var(--drift-y), 0) scale(calc(var(--scale, 1) + 0.03)); }
}
```

### Task 3: Verify rendering and shared-folder persistence

**Files:**

- [ ] **Step 1: Render the page with Playwright**

Run:

```bash
cd /home/youshaocong/hgfs/xueyinMiniapp && node - <<'NODE'
const { chromium } = require('playwright');
const path = require('node:path');
(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox'] });
  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1600 } });
  await page.goto(`file://${path.join(process.cwd(), 'newapihome/index.html')}`);
  await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/newapihome-home.png', fullPage: true });
  await browser.close();
})();
NODE
```

Expected: screenshot file created with centered logo on a black stage and scattered copy around it.
